release.notes: Nameplate reading on the phone (model code, voltage, capacity and the new maximum gross mass) with review before use, and an optional form to send the nameplate to support; searchable log markers (note, event, value); short recording now 180 s; adapter details in Debug, Remote Tuning and Adapter test; dashboard number font choice; tap the battery panel for energy, power or BMS SoC; calmer cell colours under load; tyre ▼/▲ arrows; History CSV export; odometer in drive reports; new Android Auto tiles Arrival and Pack kWh; connection errors blame another app only when the adapter is busy.
